title: 垃圾去哪儿了
subtitle: 蓝桶、绿桶和黑桶
character: wearing a red t-shirt, denim shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, thick tempera poster paint with bold black outlines, flat bright colors, simple chunky shapes, visible brush texture on off-white paper

pages.zh:
早上，我喝完了一盒牛奶。
空盒子要扔到哪里去呢？
我拿着盒子走到厨房，
看见墙边站着三个桶。
pages.scene: The little boy stands in a kitchen holding an empty milk carton, looking at three bins standing against the wall, morning light.

pages.zh:
我家门口有三个大桶：
一个蓝的，一个绿的，一个黑的。
它们长得一模一样，
只有盖子的颜色不同。
pages.scene: Three big wheeled bins standing side by side in front of a house: one with a blue lid, one with a green lid and one with a black lid, sunny driveway.

pages.zh:
蓝桶装能变成新东西的：
纸盒、报纸、
塑料瓶、玻璃瓶、
还有铝罐。
这些东西可以「回收」。
pages.scene: A blue-lidded bin with its lid open, and beside it a neat row of items: a flattened cardboard box, newspapers, a plastic bottle, a glass jar and an aluminium can.

pages.zh:
绿桶装院子里和厨房里的：
剪下来的草、落叶、
果皮、菜叶、剩饭。
这些东西以后会变成肥料。
pages.scene: A green-lidded bin with its lid open, and beside it grass clippings, fallen leaves, fruit peels and vegetable scraps in a small pile.

pages.zh:
剩下的那些，
又脏又没法变成新东西的，
就扔进黑桶。
黑桶里的东西最后会被埋起来，
所以越少越好。
pages.scene: A black-lidded bin with its lid open, holding a few crumpled wrappers and a broken plastic toy, drawn simply.

pages.zh:
我把牛奶盒冲了一下，
再用手压扁，
然后放进蓝桶。
爸爸说，洗干净、压扁，
工厂才好处理。
pages.scene: The little boy rinses a milk carton at the kitchen sink and then presses it flat with both hands, concentrating.

pages.zh:
纸箱也要压扁。
我踩在大纸箱上，
咔嚓一下，
它就变成了一张平平的板子。
pages.scene: The little boy stands on a big cardboard box flattening it with his feet, arms out for balance, laughing.

pages.zh:
每个星期有一天是收垃圾的日子。
前一天晚上，
我和爸爸一起把三个桶，
一个一个推到路边，
盖子朝着马路排好。
pages.scene: Evening on a driveway: the little boy and his father, a tall grown adult man with short black hair in a grey shirt, push the three wheeled bins to the kerb and line them up neatly facing the street.

pages.zh:
第二天一大早，
垃圾车就来了。
它开得很慢，
车身上有一只大大的机械手臂。
pages.scene: A big blue recycling truck with a mechanical side arm driving slowly along a suburban street in the early morning, dark tinted windows.

pages.zh:
机械手臂伸出来，
稳稳抱住桶的两边，
把它高高举起来——
哗啦！
桶里的东西全倒进了车厢。
pages.scene: Close view of a truck's mechanical arm gripping a blue bin and lifting it high, tipping the contents into the top of the truck, papers and bottles falling in.

pages.zh:
倒完以后，
手臂又把空桶轻轻放回路边。
垃圾车开去下一家，
一整条街都这样收过去。
pages.scene: The truck's arm setting the empty blue bin back down on the kerb, the truck moving on to the next house along the street.

pages.zh:
蓝桶里的东西，
被送到一个大工厂。
那里有长长的传送带，
东西在上面排着队往前走。
pages.scene: Inside a recycling plant: a long conveyor belt carrying mixed paper, bottles and cans forward, big machines on both sides, no people.

pages.zh:
工厂里有一块大磁铁。
它从传送带上方走过，
铁罐子唰地一下被吸了上去，
和别的东西分开了。
pages.scene: A large magnet hanging over a conveyor belt, pulling steel cans up off the belt while paper and plastic stay behind.

pages.zh:
纸和纸箱被压成大方块，
送到造纸厂。
在那里它们被泡成纸浆，
再摊平、烘干，
变成一张张新的纸。
pages.scene: Big square bales of pressed paper stacked in a yard, and beside them a simple drawing of a roll of fresh new paper coming out of a machine.

pages.zh:
塑料瓶被切成小碎片，
洗干净，熔化以后，
变成一粒粒小塑料豆。
这些小豆子，
可以做成新瓶子，也可以做成衣服。
pages.scene: A row of small piles: chopped plastic flakes, then clear plastic pellets, then a new bottle and a folded fleece jacket, arranged left to right on a plain background.

pages.zh:
绿桶里的草叶和果皮，
被堆成一座大堆，
慢慢发热、变黑，
最后变成松松软软的肥料，
给田里的植物吃。
pages.scene: A big compost heap in a yard with steam rising gently from it, and beside it dark crumbly compost being spread around young plants.

pages.zh:
所以我出门会带自己的水壶，
买东西带上布袋子。
少用一次性的东西，
黑桶里就少一点，
要埋起来的垃圾也就少一点。
pages.scene: The little boy walks out of the front door with a water bottle in one hand and a cloth shopping bag over his shoulder, cheerful morning light.

pages.zh:
垃圾车开走了。
我站在路边挥挥手。
我喝完的那个牛奶盒，
说不定过些天，
会变成我画画用的新纸呢。
pages.scene: The little boy stands on the pavement waving at the recycling truck driving away down the street, holding a sheet of paper and a crayon in his other hand.
